scientific_integrity: The qualitative kernel test for linear paramonotonicity and generic resolvent nonexpansiveness are acknowledged as known. Unindexed equivalent quantitative computations remain a literature-priority risk. No independent review, certification, or validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exact planar linear family with positive rank-one symmetric parts, fixed a,b>0, and nonzero individual skew coefficients; the singular parallel sum is interpreted as a graph-inverse relation. The main spectral and resolvent claims are proved by explicit algebra and local analysis; finite samples only check formulas.
title: A quadratic rank-one–skew resonance in planar monotone parallel sums
